answer.reason: Meshech has a few stated events: it traded with Tyre, its multitude lay slain among the uncircumcised, and its chief prince Gog was prophesied against.

clauses.english: traded persons of men and vessels of brass in Tyre's market
clauses.quote: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market

clauses.english: lay slain by the sword with all her multitude among the uncircumcised
clauses.quote: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude

clauses.english: had Gog as its chief prince, against whom the LORD set himself
clauses.quote: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal

doubts: PSA 120:5 spells it Mesech and the speaker only says he sojourned there; it adds no event, so it was left out.
ISA 66:19 lists Tubal and others as nations to which survivors are sent but does not name Meshech, so it was left out.
EZK 38-39 prophesy against Gog, so the third clause is a prophecy, not a past event; it is worded as what is stated.
